name: algorithm-paper-code-discovery-v1
description: Eight authored algorithm-engineering problems, two query formulations per task, 32 real public source identities, 4 observed publisher/DOI aliases and 8 synthetic tracking aliases. Paper titles, repository names and source URLs are public bibliographic metadata; snippets are independently authored short descriptions based on public abstracts and repository pages. Relevance judgments were assigned by task topic, not repair effectiveness; other sources are unjudged. Linked pairs reflect explicit source references, not proof of applicability or code quality. This is a fixed development fixture, not a live search result set or held-out leaderboard.
